hostname ix-v03
!
bridge irb enable
!
device GigaEthernet2
  vlan-group 1 port 1 2
  vlan-group 3 port 3
  vlan-group 4 port 4
!
interface BVI0
  ip address 192.0.2.1/25
  bridge-group 10
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  ip address 203.0.113.6/30
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2:1.0
  bridge-group 10
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2:3.0
  no shutdown
!

  encapsulation dot1q 10
  bridge-group 10
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2:3.2
  encapsulation dot1q 30
  bridge-group 30
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2:3.3
  encapsulation dot1q 40
  bridge-group 40
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2:4.0
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2:4.1

  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet2:4.2
